<!-- Use this template for branches prefixed with automation/. Replace every instruction with concrete evidence. -->

## Problem
Describe one bounded repository problem. Explain why this change is the smallest high-leverage move.

## Implemented change
List the code, tests, configuration, or validator added. State what changed in repository behavior.

## Test evidence
List exact commands and observed results, including pass/fail counts or exit codes. Never claim tests that were not run.

## Risks
Name concrete failure modes, compatibility concerns, or operational costs introduced by this change.

## Rollback
State the exact revert, disable, remove, or restore action that reverses the change.

## Privacy review
State whether the change reads, writes, or exposes private conversation text, personal data, credentials, secrets, or sensitive records.

## Next executable step
Name one bounded follow-up that can be implemented and verified independently.
